The '''Almar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained a tropical [[Unidentified world (Almar system)|world]] that was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Diet/Legends|carnivores]] known as [[marmaw]]s.<ref name="TTaBS" />
